reason: The comment at app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/discourse.scss:72-73 still says the topic-list table-cell default is `scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%)`, but the patch changed that default at app/assets/stylesheets/common/base/_topic-list.scss:55 to `dark-light-choose(scale-color($primary, $lightness: 50%), scale-color($secondary, $lightness: 50%))`. The comment is now only accurate for light themes.
